title: Shared watcher RPC cooldown: local regression proof and blocked public catch-up

sourceBinding.verification: Logs are bound to this committed SHA by root orchestration; most test logs do not embed a source SHA or clean-tree snapshot.
sourceBinding.cleanlinessEvidence: Root reported clean source for committed check, related tests and public catch-up; packaging agent independently observed HEAD 1d780ff75 and empty git status before packaging. Public-stack log embeds sourceSha and cleanBefore only.
sourceBinding.sourceCheckLimit: No claim that a later working tree or any uncommitted first-red/first-green run was clean. Logs are archived under docs/evidence; the root commit containing this package provides its durable publication boundary.

change.scope: Process-local RPC transport scheduling. No financial transition, money math, contract or lending implementation changes.
behavior: Manual pollNow and scheduled polls share one in-flight poll and one cancellable cooldown.
Transient transport failure increases the delay from at least 1000ms, doubling up to 30000ms. Successful committed cursor progress decays the delay by 25%.
Stopping the watcher releases a cooldown wait; session/generation checks prevent retired sessions from reading again.
Healthy catch-up remains immediate and idle polling keeps its configured interval.

Linked library code is checked; Account/HashLadderRegistry/NftCustody self-address slots are bound; Depository ENTITY_PROVIDER and DELTA_TRANSFORMER getters are compared to configured addresses. Other compiler-declared immutable address values are checked for valid nonzero words and consistency but are not all pinned to independently approved owner/admin identities. publicCatchup.interpretation: The cooldown fixed the local immediate-retry regression but did not unblock this public catch-up. After a successful 256-block scan, the range expanded to 512 and received 429 again; the final logged 256-block attempt also received 429.
publicCatchup.comparisonLimitation: No causal speedup claim against the prior 576-block attempt. Provider load, quota state and timing are uncontrolled.
